zh.title: 黃仁勳能不能回到董事會，誰說了算？
zh.subject: Nvidia 十位董事，坐最久的已經 33 年
zh.opener: 11 月 17 日開口說「不打算讓 Jensen 回任執行長」的董事長 Harvey Jones，1993 年就進了 Nvidia 董事會。
points: 黃仁勳辭職後，董事會剩十位，沒有一位在 Nvidia 上班。依章程，補一個董事空缺要過半數，十位要六位點頭。
董事每年改選，但候選人是董事會自己的提名委員會挑的。股東要換人，得自己提名、自己拉票。
十位董事平均坐了約 14.8 年。審計委員會主席 Brooke Seawell 坐了 29 年。
zh.chartNote: 誤差正負一年。出處：Nvidia 2026 年委託書、2026 年 5 月 8-K。

poll.q: 跟他坐了三十年的董事，該投票讓他回來嗎？

opts.t: 不該，正因為太熟要避嫌
等獨立調查的結果再說

en.title: Who decides if Jensen Huang gets his seat back?
en.subject: Nvidia's longest-serving director has been there 33 years
en.opener: The chair who said on Nov 17 that the board has no plans to bring Jensen back as CEO is Harvey Jones. He joined Nvidia's board in 1993.
points: With Jensen gone, ten directors remain, and none of them work at Nvidia. Filling a board seat takes a majority, so six of ten have to say yes.
Directors stand for election every year, but the board's own nominating committee picks the candidates. Shareholders who want change have to nominate and campaign on their own.
The ten have served about 14.8 years on average. Audit chair Brooke Seawell has been there 29.
en.imgAlt: How long each director has served
en.chartNote: Plus or minus a year. Source: Nvidia 2026 proxy statement and May 2026 8-K.

poll.q: Should directors who sat beside him for 30 years vote to bring him back?

opts.t: No, they're too close to him

zh.title: 黃仁勳回得來嗎？
zh.subject: 黃仁勳持股 3.58%，夠他回董事會嗎？
zh.opener: 11 月 17 日上午，黃仁勳說願意回任執行長；大約五個半小時後，董事長在財報會議上說不打算讓他回來。
points: 董事會說不，股東手上還有四條路：代理權之爭、proxy access（借公司的委託書提名）、股東臨時會、撤換董事。每一條都有門檻。
他持股 3.58%，跨過 proxy access 的 3% 門檻。但 Nasdaq 規定三年內當過員工的人不算獨立董事，這條路他能送兩位盟友進去，送不了自己。
回得來的創辦人，靠的不是持股。Jobs 在 1998 年的 Apple 委託書上只有 1 股；PayPal 上市前持股 13.0% 的 Musk，沒再當回執行長。
zh.imgAlt: 四條路的門檻，和他手上的票
zh.chartNote: 出處：Nvidia 章程（2024-03-12 修訂版）、Nvidia 2026 年委託書。

poll.q: 你覺得黃仁勳該走哪條路回來？

opts.t: 等董事會自己改變主意
先用 proxy access 送兩位盟友進董事會

en.title: Can Jensen Huang come back?
en.subject: Jensen owns 3.58%. Is that enough to get back on the board?
en.opener: On the morning of Nov 17, Jensen said he would return as CEO. About five and a half hours later, the chair said on the earnings call that the board has no plans to bring him back.
points: If the board says no, shareholders have four routes: a proxy fight, proxy access, a special meeting, or removing directors. Each one has a bar to clear.

His 3.58 percent clears the 3 percent bar for proxy access. But under Nasdaq rules, anyone employed by the company in the last three years isn't independent. That route can seat two allies, not Jensen himself.
Founders who made it back didn't do it on ownership. Jobs held 1 share on Apple's 1998 proxy. Musk owned 13.0 percent of PayPal before its IPO and never became CEO again.
en.imgAlt: The bar for each route, and the votes he holds
en.chartNote: Source: Nvidia bylaws (amended Mar 12, 2024) and Nvidia 2026 proxy statement.

poll.q: Which way back should Jensen take?

opts.t: Wait for the board to change its mind
Run his own proxy fight in 2027
Use proxy access to seat two allies first

zh.title: 如果你明天消失，誰會真的想你？
zh.subject: Superhuman 從 22% 做到 58%，分四步
zh.opener: Superhuman 第一次問用戶「再也不能用會怎樣」，只有 22% 說會非常失望。三季之後，是 58%。
points: 四成這條線，是 Sean Ellis 比了將近一百家新創畫出來的：成長卡住的公司，說「非常失望」的幾乎都不到四成。
Superhuman 先只看最愛它的那群人，分數從 22% 跳到 33%。接著開發時間一半加碼他們愛的，一半修卡住其他人的地方。
另外兩把尺：留存曲線要走平；一個客戶賺回的毛利（LTV），要是拿下他的成本（CAC）的三倍。先修最弱的那一把。
zh.imgAlt: 說會「非常失望」的用戶比例
zh.chartNote: 出處：Rahul Vohra，First Round Review，2018；Slack 數字是 Hiten Shah 2015 年的調查。

poll.q: 你的產品，三把尺裡最弱的是哪一把？

en.title: If you disappeared tomorrow, who'd actually miss you?
en.subject: How Superhuman went from 22% to 58%, in four steps
en.opener: The first time Superhuman asked users how they'd feel without the product, 22 percent said very disappointed. Three quarters later, it was 58.
points: Sean Ellis drew the 40 percent line after comparing nearly a hundred startups. The ones that struggled to grow almost always fell short of it.
Superhuman first looked only at the people who loved it most, and the score jumped from 22 to 33 percent. Then it split the roadmap: half on what fans love, half on what holds the near-fans back.
The other two tests: retention has to level off, and a customer has to earn back three times what it cost to win them (LTV to CAC). Fix the weakest one first.
en.imgAlt: Share of users who'd be "very disappointed"
en.chartNote: Source: Rahul Vohra, First Round Review, 2018. The Slack figure is Hiten Shah's 2015 survey.

poll.q: Which of the three tests is your product weakest on?

opts.t: Not enough people would miss it
